subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw ship a public, current-session reset capability on `after_compaction` hook contexts with deferred completion semantics?
rationale: The branch adds a permanent plugin API and session-lifecycle capability; code review can validate safety mechanics, but only an owner can confirm that this is the intended supported contract and define where it must be available.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow hook API
options.body: Approve the after-success, current-session-only capability, require the outermost queue owner and positive live proof, and document that the returned result acknowledges queueing rather than reset completion.

options.title: Keep reset gateway-owned
options.body: Decline the plugin API and instead implement the affected recovery policy inside the gateway or context-engine owner without exposing a general hook capability.

options.title: Pause for a broader lifecycle design
options.body: Hold this PR until reset, compaction, and plugin lifecycle APIs are designed together with explicit completion and failure semantics.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow hook API
recommendation.body: Approve the after-success, current-session-only capability, require the outermost queue owner and positive live proof, and document that the returned result acknowledges queueing rather than reset completion.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal covers recent compaction, memory-flush, and session-lifecycle product behavior.
